texts.li: [winter] Winter is when the colony has the least to do in the fields and the most to do everywhere else. {A_nameDef} wants to spend it trying to {GOAL}, and has asked the council to take {A_objective} off the chore roster until spring.\n\nThe others would have to cover, and they've noticed.

[colony:Hardworking] Nobody in this colony gets let off chores, and {A_nameDef} knows it. {A_nameDef} is asking anyway: a season off the roster, to finally {GOAL}.\n\nThe others are waiting to see what the council says.

[colony:Thrifty] {A_nameDef} knows how the colony feels about spending, and has brought a plan anyway: 150 silver from the purse for what {A_pronoun} needs to {GOAL}, with every coin accounted for on a sheet of paper.

[trait:Greedy] {A_nameDef} wants 150 silver from the colony's purse to {GOAL}, and has made a list of what it will buy. Some of the others have read the list and are asking pointed questions about the third item.

[b:past:soldier] {B_nameDef} once ran a company of soldiers, and {A_nameDef} has decided that someone who can organize a war can organize anything. {A_nameDef} wants {B_nameDef}'s help to {GOAL}, every evening, for a season.\n\n{B_nameDef} has been asked, and has asked for time to think.

[b:past:scholar] {B_nameDef} used to teach, before the colony, and {A_nameDef} has found out. {A_nameDef} wants {B_nameDef}'s evenings to learn how to {GOAL}.\n\n{B_nameDef} would like the council to decide whether {B_pronoun} has any say in it.
[b:trait:Abrasive] {B_nameDef} has a nickname for {A_nameDef}'s dream to {GOAL}, and has been using it at every meal. {A_nameDef} has had enough, and both of them have brought it to the council.
[colony:Hardworking] {B_nameDef} says a colony that works as hard as this one has no room for {A_nameDef}'s wish to {GOAL}, and says it loudly. {A_nameDef} wants the council to say otherwise.

[winter] Over the winter {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have both been chasing their dreams in the evenings, and they keep wanting the same bench, the same tools and the same spare hours. {A_nameDef} wants to {GOAL}. {B_nameDef} wants something else entirely.\n\nThey've asked the council to say whose comes first.

[spring] The roads are open again, and the first caravan of the spring is due any day. {A_nameDef} has been watching for it. {A_nameDef} wants to {GOAL}, and has started to think it might happen somewhere else.\n\n{A_nameDef} has asked for the council's blessing to go.

[past:trader] {A_nameDef} spent years on the roads before the colony, and the itch has come back. {A_nameDef} wants to {GOAL}, and thinks the next caravan might be the way to do it.\n\n{A_nameDef} wants to know what the council thinks before deciding.

[winter] {A_nameDef} has spent the winter evenings by the stove, staring at the plans to {GOAL} and not touching them. Last night {A_nameDef} fed the first page to the fire.\n\n{A_nameDef}'s friends have asked the council to do something before the rest of it goes the same way.

[afterraid] After the last attack, {A_nameDef} came to the council with a request. If the next one takes {A_objective} before {A_pronoun} can {GOAL}, {A_nameDef} wants the colony to remember it was the dream.\n\n{B_nameDef} was in the room, and hasn't said a word since.
